posts.cooked: I've always liked the art on Mystical Divergence. I agree that Impromptu Invention is a pretty uber card for all the stuff it can do. posts.name: jesse_garcia_87
posts.cooked:
Art/Storyline adder: Iron Legacy's Former Allies card. There's so much said in just that artwork, a broken picture frame of happier times, rain splashing down as mud covers the edges... I mean, a lot of Iron Legacie's deck goes through his rising to power, taking over the world, beating down the heros, it's just so deliciously filled with gooey tales of sorrow and confusion.

 

as far as abilities go? Twist the Aether. i've seen so much use out of that either on friend or foe. and Omnitron (original flavor or with Cosmic Flakes) and his Adaptive Subroutines can't stop an ally with that on them :D

Favorite Cards:

 

ZEALOUS OFFENSE!!!  Best card in the game.  It shuts down EPE, T-Rex, The Conqueror and The Stalwart, Mystical Defenses, Sonic Mine, Treacherous Ape and so many more.  And the only cost is you have to hurt things.  Yeah.  Best Card Ever.  (sorry Guise, you got the second best)

 

[REDACTED], [REDACTED], and [REDACTED].  I'm sorry to be that guy, but Stuntman.  You guys have to wait, but there are so many great cards in his deck.  The art, text, effects, it's glorious.  I'm sorry you all have to wait to see them.

 

Final Dive.  Yep, more Fanatic.  Such an amazingly powerful card, and so thematically awesome.  Love it.

 

Bloogo.  He's the best.

posts.name: Jeysie
posts.cooked:
The artwork on Temporal Event in Silver Gulch makes me giggle every time I look at it. The combo of Wraith's cartoony bug-eyed face and Argent's dejected staring contest with a lizard is delightfully absurd.

Construct Cataclysm, for being Badass Hilarious and showing how British Captain Cosmic is.

Haka of Shielding is another card with delightfully absurd art.  It's the balloon that really makes it.

Everything with Idealist on it. Especially her foil incap for her original version.

Setback's entire deck is great, but I especially like the flavor text for High Risk Behavior. "Oh, hello there! Have you considered, say, not hitting me?"

Aquatic Correspondence. :D That poor eel...

I am sad Unity won't have any more canon bots, because I want to see what her quips would be for all the other heroes' expies.

Tactics has a lot of funny cards, too. Bunker complaining that Wraith stole his foam grenades, Citizen Spring being all a-gosh at how violent Beacon is, Wraith complaining that AZ got her making cheesy ice puns...

My favorite card to use is probably Suggestion. Nice and simple, and against most villains, can get you a known breather for the next round. 

I also have a special place in my heart for Wrest the Mind, which I've had a couple of, shall we say, animated discussions about with SOTM-playing coworkers. Sure, I don't always find a way to use it, but there have been times where WTM has literally won me the game.

(Yes, Visionary is my most played character, why do you ask)
